decisions.reason: The authentication and identity delegation service is close to the firm's geospatial IT integration know-how, and it was moved to a page of its own in 2024, so the R&D-active firm can interpret early results and refine it.

The open GIS application development framework builds directly on the firm's open, extensible component expertise and its standards work, although the website still only mentions it without giving it more visibility.

The identity service for GIS applications is close to the firm's core, was announced as a launch, and gained a page of its own with sharper messaging in 2024, which shows active assimilation and development.

The geodata business process consulting workshop builds on the firm's long consulting and training experience, so it is a low-risk extension of what the firm already knows and fits its user-centred strategy.
